title: Frontier LLMs powering coding agents for image creation and editing
year_policy: First public preprint when available; not the conference publication year.
scope: LLM coding agents and executable workflows for image creation, editing and reconstruction; explicitly labeled adjacent agents, components and benchmarks.

groups.code: Code-rendered graphics, scientific communication and editable design
groups.editing: Editing, restoration and visual tool agents
groups.learning: Learning, visual rewards and harness optimization

records.name: AgentDrawBench
records.title: How Far Can Coding Agents Go in Visual Generation?
records.mechanism: General coding agents draw through pixels, shapes, Canvas 2D, SVG and Blender; a separate GUI setting draws without code.
records.evidence: Paper §§3–5: 200-prompt AgentDrawBench; structural checklists, perceptual criteria and pairwise preference.
records.caveat: Zero-shot permits multiple execution turns. Structural fidelity and perceptual quality differ; GUI is a comparison, not coding.

records.name: MaLiang-Harness
records.title: MaLiang-Harness: A Programmable Path to Image and Video Generation
records.mechanism: Maintains executable state, edit-to-render traces and revision-aware verification across generation and repair.
records.evidence: Introduces MaLiang-IBench and MaLiang-VBench; reports delivery, quality and cost.
records.caveat: Only its image track is surveyed here; runnable output is distinct from satisfying visual requirements.

records.name: GenClaw
records.title: GenClaw: Code-Driven Agentic Image Generation
records.mechanism: Search/reasoning creates structured intent; SVG, HTML, Python or Three.js renders a canvas; image models supply appearance, with visual review and localized correction.
records.evidence: Full-text §§3–4 identifies code backends and task-specific evaluations; physical-simulation examples are qualitative.
records.caveat: A correct draft does not guarantee neural final pixels preserve every relation; report generator and agent backbone separately.

records.name: CoCo
records.title: CoCo: Code as CoT for Text-to-Image Preview and Rare Concept Generation
records.mechanism: The model writes executable structural code, renders a deterministic sandboxed draft, then refines it through image editing.
records.evidence: Primary abstract and method identify CoCo-10K draft/final supervision and code-as-reasoning.
records.caveat: A staged learned pipeline; image refinement is not evidence of a repeated external code-repair loop.

records.name: Editable Visual Design
records.title: Editable Visual Design
records.mechanism: A coding agent plans visual intent, requests separate image assets, writes native HTML/CSS, and patches code after browser/layout and VLM visual checks.
records.evidence: Full-text §2 describes DOM layers and real text; §3 supplies comparative cases, showcases and replay trajectories.
records.caveat: Evidence is qualitative case study/showcase; there is no named quantitative benchmark in §3. Do not assert universal production-grade success.

records.name: VISPROG
records.title: Visual Programming: Compositional visual reasoning without training
records.mechanism: Generates Python-like modular programs that invoke vision models and image-processing routines; intermediate outputs become inputs to later instructions.
records.evidence: The paper explicitly includes language-guided image editing alongside reasoning and tagging.
records.caveat: The 2022 preprint precedes CVPR 2023; its VQA results are not image-editing evidence.

records.name: Visual ChatGPT
records.title: Visual ChatGPT: Talking, Drawing and Editing with Visual Foundation Models
records.mechanism: Connects a conversational LLM to visual foundation models through prompts describing tool interfaces and intermediate files.
records.evidence: The abstract describes multistep editing requests and user-requested corrections.
records.caveat: A tool-using precursor; do not equate every conversation with autonomous source-code repair.

records.name: HuggingGPT
records.title: HuggingGPT: Solving AI Tasks with ChatGPT and its Friends in Hugging Face
records.mechanism: Uses an LLM to plan tasks, select models from their descriptions, execute subtasks and summarize results.
records.evidence: The abstract verifies the four-stage model-orchestration pipeline.
records.caveat: General multimodal task orchestration; not a dedicated image-coding benchmark.

records.name: MM-REACT
records.title: MM-REACT: Prompting ChatGPT for Multimodal Reasoning and Action
records.mechanism: Connects ChatGPT with vision experts using textual descriptions, spatial coordinates and file references.
records.evidence: Primary abstract describes zero-shot visual reasoning and tool integration.
records.caveat: Included as interface background, not evidence that the system generates editable image source.

records.name: LLM-grounded Diffusion (LMD)
records.title: LLM-grounded Diffusion: Enhancing Prompt Understanding of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with Large Language Models
records.mechanism: An LLM produces captioned object bounding boxes; a layout-grounding controller steers a pretrained diffusion model.
records.evidence: Primary abstract documents two stages without additional parameter optimization and multi-round scene specification.
records.caveat: Layout planning and user interaction do not by themselves establish autonomous coding-agent feedback.

records.name: LayoutGPT
records.title: LayoutGPT: Compositional Visual Planning and Generation with Large Language Models
records.mechanism: Style-sheet-formatted in-context examples guide an LLM to plan 2D image layouts or 3D indoor arrangements.
records.evidence: Primary abstract reports numerical/spatial layout evaluation and downstream image generation.
records.caveat: Style-sheet-like representation is structured planning; do not equate it with an executing browser agent.

records.name: VPGen / VPEval
records.title: Visual Programming for Text-to-Image Generation and Evaluation
records.task: Visual programs for generation and evaluation
records.mechanism: VPGen decomposes generation into object/count, layout and image stages; VPEval creates programs invoking skill-specific visual evaluators.
records.evidence: Primary abstract describes a language model fine-tuned on text-layout pairs and explanatory visual evaluation programs.
records.caveat: VPGen and VPEval are two frameworks in one paper, not two independent publications; VPEval is an evaluator, not a generator.

records.name: LLM Blueprint
records.title: LLM Blueprint: Enabling Text-to-Image Generation with Complex and Detailed Prompts
records.mechanism: An LLM extracts boxes, object descriptions and background; global scene generation is followed by box-level evaluation and iterative recomposition.
records.evidence: Primary abstract explicitly describes the iterative refinement scheme and a user study.
records.caveat: The feedback loop operates on scene/object content, not an arbitrary maintained codebase.

records.name: Ranni
records.title: Ranni: Taming Text-to-Image Diffusion for Accurate Instruction Following
records.mechanism: Language parsing creates a semantic panel that controls the denoiser; users can edit panel elements or supply language changes.
records.evidence: Primary abstract documents the formatting protocol, automatic data preparation, and continuous/chat-based editing.
records.caveat: Human adjustment is an interaction attribute, not W4 autonomous environmental operation.

records.name: Control-GPT
records.title: Controllable Text-to-Image Generation with GPT-4
records.mechanism: GPT-4 writes TikZ sketches that condition a diffusion pipeline alongside text. Polygonized instance masks supply training sketches.
records.evidence: Primary abstract explicitly identifies generated TikZ and ControlNet-style conditioning.
records.caveat: A staged program-to-image method; not evidence of a persistent autonomous code-repair loop.

records.name: Idea2Img
records.title: Idea2Img: Iterative Self-Refinement with GPT-4V(ision) for Automatic Image Design and Generation
records.mechanism: GPT-4V generates and critiques draft images through revised T2I prompts, conditioned on memory of the probed generator.
records.evidence: Primary abstract and official project describe interleaved image-text ideas and a user preference study.
records.caveat: A visual feedback baseline; the editable optimization variable is primarily the prompt, not renderer source.

records.name: GenArtist
records.title: GenArtist: Multimodal LLM as an Agent for Unified Image Generation and Editing
records.mechanism: A multimodal agent decomposes requests into a tree of generation, editing and self-correction operations, with stepwise verification and position-related inputs.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies the tool library, tree planning and self-correction mechanism.
records.caveat: Tool orchestration is core to image agents broadly; source-code generation is not established by the checked abstract.

records.name: ComfyBench / ComfyAgent
records.title: ComfyBench: Benchmarking LLM-based Agents in ComfyUI for Autonomously Designing Collaborative AI Systems
records.mechanism: ComfyAgent represents workflows as code reversibly converted to executable ComfyUI graphs; cooperating agents learn from existing workflows and construct new ones.
records.evidence: Primary abstract gives benchmark and agent together and separates workflow design from task resolution.
records.caveat: ComfyBench includes modalities beyond images; use its image-relevant tasks and do not interpret execution success as instruction satisfaction.

records.name: StarVector
records.title: StarVector: Generating Scalable Vector Graphics Code from Images and Text
records.mechanism: Uses a multimodal language model to emit SVG source with semantic primitives from visual or text inputs.
records.evidence: Abstract and author project describe SVG-Stack and SVG-Bench.
records.caveat: First preprint is 2023; CVPR publication is 2025. Single-pass model is not a full repair harness.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: AutomaTikZ
records.title: AutomaTikZ: Text-Guided Synthesis of Scientific Vector Graphics with TikZ
records.mechanism: Fine-tunes language models to map captions to compilable TikZ drawing programs.
records.evidence: Primary abstract describes DaTikZ and text-conditioned vector program synthesis.
records.caveat: Direct conditional generation is not by itself an execution-feedback agent.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: MatPlotAgent
records.title: MatPlotAgent: Method and Evaluation for LLM-Based Agentic Scientific Data Visualization
records.mechanism: Understands the request, writes plotting code, debugs execution failures and corrects charts with visual feedback.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies these three modules and MatPlotBench.
records.caveat: Model-based visual ratings do not by themselves guarantee correct data transformation.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: DiagramAgent
records.title: From Words to Structured Visuals: A Benchmark and Framework for Text-to-Diagram Generation and Editing
records.mechanism: Separates planning, code production, checking and diagram-to-code conversion into cooperating modules.
records.evidence: Primary abstract and official repository verify four named modules and generation/refinement tasks.
records.caveat: A multi-agent label alone does not imply human-free operation across every supported editing mode.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: PosterVerse
records.title: PosterVerse: A Full-Workflow Framework for Commercial-Grade Poster Generation with HTML-Based Scalable Typography
records.mechanism: A fine-tuned LLM produces a design blueprint, diffusion generates graphical backgrounds, and an MLLM-powered HTML engine handles typography and layout.
records.evidence: Primary abstract identifies the three stages and PosterDNA HTML-based data.
records.caveat: Commercial-grade is the authors label, not an independently verified guarantee; HTML text can still have layout errors.

records.name: ComfyMind
records.title: ComfyMind: Toward General-Purpose Generation via Tree-Based Planning and Reactive Feedback
records.mechanism: A Semantic Workflow Interface exposes functional modules over ComfyUI nodes; tree-based planning uses localized execution feedback.
records.evidence: Primary abstract identifies the module interface, hierarchical planning and evaluation on three public benchmarks.
records.caveat: General-purpose generation spans multiple tasks; the graph/module interface is more constrained than arbitrary source-code synthesis.

records.name: COMFYCLAW
records.title: COMFYCLAW: Self-Evolving Skill Harnesses for Image Generation Workflows
records.mechanism: Typed ComfyUI graph editing rolls back invalid changes; a region-level VLM verifier recommends repairs; trajectories become reusable skills.
records.evidence: Full-text §4 and appendices evaluate graph/workflow agents on compositional and multilingual prompt suites.
records.caveat: The paper uses a particular VLM judge implementation; prompt and sampler edits dominate many runs, so graph-editing availability is not identical to frequent structural edits.

records.name: InstructPix2Pix
records.title: InstructPix2Pix: Learning to Follow Image Editing Instructions
records.mechanism: A conditional diffusion model learns instruction-guided image editing from generated examples.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies image-plus-instruction conditioning and the training-data construction.
records.caveat: A language model helps construct training examples; deployment is not thereby an autonomous coding agent.

records.name: AgenticIR
records.title: An Intelligent Agentic System for Complex Image Restoration Problems
records.mechanism: Uses perception, scheduling, execution, reflection and rescheduling, with learned degradation judgments and self-exploration summaries for planning.
records.evidence: Section 4 constructs mixed-degradation tests from MiO100; workflow ablations test reflection and rollback.
records.caveat: Restoration operates specialist tools rather than synthesizing arbitrary renderer code.

records.name: VisionDirector
records.title: VisionDirector: Vision-Language Guided Closed-Loop Refinement for Generative Image Synthesis
records.mechanism: Extracts structured goals, chooses direct generation or staged edits, and applies semantic checks with rollback; an additional GRPO-trained planner is reported.
records.evidence: Primary abstract introduces LGBench and explicitly mentions GenEval and ImgEdit evaluations.
records.caveat: Separate the training-free supervisor from the fine-tuned planner variant.

records.name: RISE-Agent / RISEBench++
records.title: Reasoning-Informed Visual Editing
records.mechanism: Plans target states with reasoning tools, emits generative prompts or declarative programs, executes deterministic canvas operations or neural edits, then accepts, refines or replans.
records.evidence: Section 3.4 specifies programmatic operations and code-based reasoning solvers; main experiments use RISEBench++ and Appendix B uses KRIS-Bench.
records.caveat: RISEBench++ extends the earlier RISE benchmark; distinguish benchmark evidence from the proposed agent.

records.name: OmniSVG
records.title: OmniSVG: A Unified Scalable Vector Graphics Generation Model
records.mechanism: Adapts a pretrained VLM with discrete SVG command and coordinate tokenization for autoregressive conditional synthesis.
records.evidence: Abstract and official paper cover text, image and character-reference conditions.
records.caveat: Do not infer render-inspect-repair inference from its training pipeline.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: Scene Language
records.title: The Scene Language: Representing Scenes with Programs, Words, and Embeddings
records.mechanism: Combines hierarchical programs, semantic words and identity embeddings with traditional, neural or hybrid renderers.
records.evidence: Primary abstract supports text/image conditioning and editable scene structure.
records.caveat: Representation and rendering framework; no generic inference repair loop inferred here.

records.name: DeTikZify
records.title: DeTikZify: Synthesizing Graphics Programs for Scientific Figures and Sketches with TikZ
records.mechanism: A multimodal model produces TikZ; MCTS-based inference searches and refines candidate programs.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies sketch/image inputs, graphics-program output and MCTS inference.
records.caveat: Distinguish inference-time program search from dialogue with human editors.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: VIGA
records.title: Vision-as-Inverse-Graphics Agent via Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning
records.mechanism: Interleaves code synthesis, rendering and discrepancy inspection with skills and multimodal memory.
records.evidence: Primary abstract reports BlenderGym, SlideBench and introduced BlenderBench.
records.caveat: Only image/document reconstruction and the render-inspect mechanism are in scope.

records.name: InternSVG
records.title: InternSVG: Towards Unified SVG Tasks with Multimodal Large Language Models
records.mechanism: Unifies SVG tasks with special tokens and staged training from short static graphics to long illustrations and animation.
records.evidence: Primary abstract and author project identify SAgoge and SArena.
records.caveat: Static tasks are in scope; the presence of animation tasks does not turn the model into a persistent interactive agent.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: SVGenius
records.title: SVGenius: Benchmarking LLMs in SVG Understanding, Editing and Generation
records.mechanism: Evaluates understanding, editing and generation with task and complexity stratification.
records.evidence: Primary abstract describes real-world SVG coverage and multiple evaluation dimensions.
records.caveat: This is a task suite, not a single aggregate measure of autonomous visual delivery.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: LIDA
records.title: LIDA: A Tool for Automatic Generation of Grammar-Agnostic Visualizations and Infographics using Large Language Models
records.mechanism: Summarizes data, proposes goals, generates/executes/refines visualization code and optionally stylizes the result using an image generator.
records.evidence: Primary abstract and official repository identify the four modules and supported edit/evaluate/repair operations.
records.caveat: Image stylization needs separate data-fidelity checks; a code-correct chart does not certify subsequent raster changes.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: Chat2SVG
records.title: Chat2SVG: Vector Graphics Generation with Large Language Models and Image Diffusion Models
records.mechanism: LLM prompt expansion and SVG template construction include rendered visual correction; diffusion-guided optimization then refines paths.
records.evidence: CVPR paper section 3.1 explicitly renders templates and returns images to the VLM for corrected code.
records.caveat: The later geometric optimization is distinct from the LLM visual feedback loop.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: Render-in-the-Loop
records.title: Render-in-the-Loop: Vector Graphics Generation via Visual Self-Feedback
records.mechanism: Conditions successive primitives on cumulative rendered canvases using Visual Self-Feedback training and Render-and-Verify inference.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies intermediate renders, trajectory supervision and filtering of redundant/degenerate primitives.
records.caveat: Incremental feedback is a trained capability; naive visual prompting is not claimed sufficient.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: RefineSVG
records.title: RefineSVG: Visual Feedback-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Image-to-SVG Generation
records.mechanism: Renders an initial SVG, compares it to the target using a visual residual Diff-Map and generates a targeted correction.
records.evidence: Primary abstract specifies a single correction step and agentic reinforcement-learning pipeline.
records.caveat: Single-step closed-loop correction should not be presented as unrestricted multi-step planning.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: VisCoder
records.title: VisCoder: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Executable Python Visualization Code Generation
records.mechanism: Fine-tunes code models with validated plotting examples and multi-turn runtime-feedback correction dialogues.
records.evidence: Primary abstract identifies VisCode-200K and self-debug evaluation.
records.caveat: Execution pass rate measures whether a visual is produced, not whether all scientific semantics are correct.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: Feynman
records.title: Feynman: Knowledge-Infused Diagramming Agent for Scalable Visual Designs
records.mechanism: Plans domain ideas, writes declarative Penrose programs and visually refines them with feedback.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies feedback and optimization-based Penrose rendering.
records.caveat: Diagramma measures visual reasoning over generated diagrams; it is not itself a code-agent delivery benchmark.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: AutoFigure
records.title: AutoFigure: Generating and Refining Publication-Ready Scientific Illustrations
records.mechanism: Refines an SVG/HTML symbolic layout, uses its rasterization to condition image synthesis, then verifies and overlays corrected text.
records.evidence: Primary full text sections 4 and Appendix M specify the code layout, critique/refinement and aesthetic-rendering stages.
records.caveat: The original system does not make every synthesized icon editable; AutoFigure-Edit is a distinct extension.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: PaperVizAgent / PaperBanana
records.title: PaperBanana: Automating Academic Illustration for AI Scientists
records.mechanism: Coordinates retrieval, planning, styling, visualization and critique; diagram generation uses image models while statistical plots can use executable Python.
records.evidence: Primary paper abstract and Google Research blog confirm the two rendering routes and rename to PaperVizAgent.
records.caveat: Do not describe all outputs as editable code; PaperBanana and PaperVizAgent are one framework, not two works.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: Paper2Poster / PosterAgent
records.title: Paper2Poster: Towards Multimodal Poster Automation from Scientific Papers
records.mechanism: Parses paper assets, plans a binary-tree layout and refines panels with executable rendering code and VLM feedback.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies Parser, Planner and Painter–Commenter loop plus editable PPTX output.
records.caveat: Its PosterAgent is distinct from Yu et al. 2026 PosterAgent trained with SARL.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: EvoDesign / EvoDiagram
records.title: EvoDesign: Agentic Editable Diagram Creation via Design Expertise Evolution
records.mechanism: Uses an intermediate object-level canvas schema with agents for design layers and hierarchical memory distilled from execution traces.
records.evidence: Current arXiv v2 title says EvoDesign while abstract retains EvoDiagram; both names refer to one work.
records.caveat: No independent new work should be created for the title change; detailed visual feedback cadence was not verified.
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: Designer-RSI
records.title: Designer-RSI: Evolving Procedural Memory from User Traffic for Agentic Graphic Design
records.task: editable graphic design and procedural memory
records.mechanism: A frozen model controls design tools while natural-language procedural memory grows and improves through execution traces and replay-gated updates.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies skill-bank adaptation and reported general/specialized design evaluations.
records.caveat: No model weight updates; improvements concern a particular software/tool harness and evaluation protocol.
related_benchmarks: Author specialized design and user-brief evaluations
records.evidence_level: primary abstract/project or paper passage inspected

records.name: RPG
records.title: Mastering Text-to-Image Diffusion: Recaptioning, Planning, and Generating with Multimodal LLMs
records.mechanism: A multimodal LLM recaptions and divides complex prompts into subregion plans; complementary regional diffusion renders them, with a generation-editing extension.
records.evidence: Primary abstract explicitly describes regional composition and closed-loop integration.
records.caveat: A region planning framework, not automatically a general-purpose source-code agent.

records.name: DraCo
records.title: DraCo: Draft as CoT for Text-to-Image Preview and Rare Concept Generation
records.mechanism: A low-resolution image draft supports visual verification, selective correction and super-resolution; training develops correction, manipulation and layout skills.
records.evidence: Primary abstract identifies DraCo-240K and evaluation on GenEval, Imagine-Bench and GenEval++.
records.caveat: DraCo generates neural image drafts; it does not generate executable code. Keep separate from CoCo.

records.name: PSP-DiT
records.title: Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer
records.mechanism: A diffusion transformer jointly denoises image and scene-program latents with grounding and cycle-consistency objectives.
records.evidence: Primary abstract states compositional evaluations under matched settings.
records.caveat: A scene program latent is not executable code and the method is not an autonomous coding agent.

records.name: ComfyGPT
records.title: ComfyGPT: A Self-Optimizing Multi-Agent System for Comprehensive ComfyUI Workflow Generation
records.mechanism: ReformatAgent, FlowAgent, RefineAgent and ExecuteAgent construct node connections and improve workflow generation, including reinforcement learning.
records.evidence: Primary abstract introduces FlowDataset, FlowBench and format/pass/alignment/diversity metrics.
records.caveat: Graph and execution metrics measure distinct properties; a valid workflow may generate a semantically wrong image.

records.name: SymbOmni
records.title: SymbOmni: Evolving Agentic Omni Models via Symbolic Concept Learning
records.mechanism: A Symbolic Concept Box abstracts operations into reusable workflow instructions; induction/transduction and language feedback support cumulative adaptation.
records.evidence: Primary abstract specifies verbalized feedback without gradient-based model fine-tuning.
records.caveat: Symbolic workflows are reusable procedural knowledge; do not describe this as neural image-model weight training.

records.name: OmniHarness
records.title: OmniHarness: Harnessing Generalizable Visual Generation via Symbolic Policy Learning
records.mechanism: Self-directed practice creates symbolic workflow policies and failure knowledge; intermediate verification drives local recovery; policies can be frozen and reused.
records.evidence: Primary abstract and official implementation describe compiling restricted Python-like Code-as-Policy to ComfyUI graphs.
records.caveat: Generated Python-like text is compiled, not directly executed as Python. Frozen and online evolving memory are different evaluation protocols.

records.name: GenAgent (2026)
records.title: GenAgent: Scaling Text-to-Image Generation via Agentic Multimodal Reasoning
records.mechanism: A multimodal agent invokes image generators as tools, judges outputs and reflects; SFT and agentic RL train tool calls and reflection.
records.evidence: Primary abstract states pointwise image-quality and pairwise reflection rewards.
records.caveat: This is an agent policy over tools; no arbitrary source-code generation is established by the abstract.

records.name: Qwen-Image-Agent
records.title: Qwen-Image-Agent: Bridging the Context Gap in Real-World Image Generation
records.mechanism: Context-aware planning identifies missing information; reasoning, search, memory and feedback supply the generation context.
records.evidence: Primary abstract introduces IA-Bench capabilities: Plan, Reason, Search and Memory.
records.caveat: An agent layer around image generation; source-code or typed-graph construction is not established in the abstract.

records.name: ToolArtist
records.title: ToolArtist: Tool-Using Unified Multimodal Models for Agentic Image Generation
records.mechanism: A post-trained unified multimodal policy coordinates reasoning, external tools and native image generation; RAD-GRPO optimizes intent and quality rewards.
records.evidence: Primary abstract explains conversion of teacher tool trajectories into a native-generation policy.
records.caveat: Native image generation replaces the exposed image tool in the student; it is not synonymous with code-rendered output.

records.name: CanvasAgent
records.title: CanvasAgent: Enabling Complex Image Creation and Editing via Visual Tool Orchestration
records.mechanism: SFT and GRPO train executable reasoning/action trajectories over generation, localization, segmentation, editing, compositing, OCR and enhancement tools.
records.evidence: Primary abstract identifies CanvasCraft, intermediate inspection, asset tracking, and outcome/process rewards.
records.caveat: Executable tool trajectories are not necessarily arbitrary source code; track tool validity and image success independently.

records.name: T2I-Copilot
records.title: T2I-Copilot: A Training-Free Multi-Agent Text-to-Image System for Enhanced Prompt Interpretation and Interactive Generation
records.mechanism: Input Interpreter resolves ambiguities; Generation Engine selects tools; Quality Evaluator supplies alignment/aesthetic feedback for regeneration.
records.evidence: Primary abstract and ICCV page confirm both autonomous operation and human-in-the-loop intervention.
records.caveat: Human feedback must be reported separately when comparing autonomous quality or cost.

records.name: Ranger / Savanna
records.title: Agentic Image Generation in the Wild
records.mechanism: Locate-Corroborate-Isolate resolves identity with text search, corroborates image candidates across sources and crops a reference for synthesis.
records.evidence: Primary abstract introduces Savanna, a recent-headline benchmark, and Ranger-8B trained on search trajectories.
records.caveat: A search score measures reference retrieval; it is not interchangeable with final image quality or general agent competence.

records.name: AutoRef
records.title: AutoRef: Harness Optimization for Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation
records.mechanism: A coding agent rewrites the generation harness while the reasoning and image models remain frozen.
records.evidence: Primary abstract separates proposal-feedback and candidate-selection tasks, then tests held-out MultiBanana tasks.
records.caveat: Cross-task harness search is distinct from revising one image; prevent selection/test leakage.

records.name: MGIE
records.title: Guiding Instruction-based Image Editing via Multimodal Large Language Models
records.mechanism: Learns expressive editing instructions and latent visual guidance through an MLLM coupled with an image editor.
records.evidence: The abstract reports global photo optimization, local editing and Photoshop-style modifications.
records.caveat: End-to-end editing model, not an autonomous code-execution agent.

records.name: EditWorld (image editing)
records.title: EditWorld: Simulating World Dynamics for Instruction-Following Image Editing
records.mechanism: Constructs world-instruction editing data using pretrained models and trains an editor with a post-edit strategy.
records.evidence: The abstract defines world-instructed image editing and evaluates on its curated task.
records.caveat: Not the unrelated 2026 video-world model also named EditWorld; no evidence of a general-purpose coding harness.

records.name: ControlNet
records.title: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
records.mechanism: Adds spatial conditions such as edges, depth or segmentation to pretrained diffusion models.
records.evidence: Primary abstract describes the architecture and multiple conditioning types.
records.caveat: A conditioning mechanism, not a planner or coding-agent policy.

records.name: ControlLLM
records.title: ControlLLM: Augment Language Models with Tools by Searching on Graphs
records.mechanism: Decomposes requests, searches a pre-built tool-dependency graph and executes the selected path.
records.evidence: Abstract and ECCV paper confirm decomposition, Thoughts-on-Graph and the execution engine.
records.caveat: Do not confuse with the unrelated 2025 Control LLM model-retention paper.

records.name: CLOVA
records.title: CLOVA: A Closed-Loop Visual Assistant with Tool Usage and Update
records.mechanism: Generates programs and executes tools; reflects on human feedback to locate tool failures and updates tools with acquired data and prompt tuning.
records.evidence: Primary abstract explicitly includes image-editing evaluation and inference-reflection-learning stages.
records.caveat: Human feedback and tool learning are part of the design; not a fully autonomous frozen-tool baseline.

records.name: CoSTA*
records.title: CoSTA*: Cost-Sensitive Toolpath Agent for Multi-turn Image Editing
records.mechanism: An LLM builds a subtask tree; graph pruning and A* search select tool paths, with VLM outcome checks updating tool costs and quality after failures.
records.evidence: The primary abstract verifies cost-quality-aware search; FaSTA* §5.1 documents the shared evaluation set.
records.caveat: The released benchmark mixes image and text operations; report its own cost-quality protocol rather than comparing raw scores to unrelated editing benchmarks.
records.evidence_granularity: primary abstract and related primary full text
records.evidence_level: primary abstract and related primary full text

records.name: FaSTA*
records.title: FaSTA*: Fast-Slow Toolpath Agent with Subroutine Mining for Efficient Multi-turn Image Editing
records.mechanism: Mines reusable symbolic subroutines from successful tool paths; tries the fast path first and falls back to local A* search on failure.
records.evidence: Section 5.1 uses the CoSTA* benchmark, human subtask accuracy and execution cost; Appendix A reports qualitative MagicBrush generalization.
records.caveat: MagicBrush examples are qualitative in the inspected version, not its principal quantitative benchmark.

records.name: MIRA
records.title: MIRA: Multimodal Iterative Reasoning Agent for Image Editing
records.mechanism: Predicts the next atomic edit from the current image and instruction rather than committing to a static plan; trained with SFT and GRPO.
records.evidence: Section 5.1 evaluates on 500 samples built from the MagicBrush multi-turn subset and a CompBench subset, with standardized images and limited instruction length.
records.caveat: Calling an editor via refined instructions is agentic control, not evidence that MIRA writes renderer source.

records.name: EditThinker
records.title: EditThinker: Unlocking Iterative Reasoning for Any Image Editor
records.mechanism: A trained MLLM critiques outputs, reasons about errors and refines the next editing instruction, repeating until a stop decision.
records.evidence: Official repository names evaluations on ImgEdit-Bench, GEdit-Bench, RISE-Bench and KRIS-Bench.
records.caveat: This is instruction refinement around external editors; do not describe it as free-form code repair.

records.name: IMAGAgent
records.title: IMAGAgent: Orchestrating Multi-Turn Image Editing via Constraint-Aware Planning and Reflection
records.mechanism: Builds atomic constraints, orchestrates retrieval/detection/segmentation/editing tools using current state and history, and aggregates multiple VLM critiques for repair.
records.evidence: The abstract and paper §IV identify MTEditBench and MagicBrush as evaluation datasets.
records.caveat: Multi-expert critique does not establish independent critic errors; qualify evidence by the tested tools and judges.

records.name: RefineEdit-Agent
records.title: An LLM-LVLM Driven Agent for Iterative and Fine-Grained Image Editing
records.mechanism: Parses instructions and scenes with an LVLM, decomposes goals with an LLM, selects editing tools and iterates from visual feedback.
records.evidence: Primary abstract introduces LongBench-T2I-Edit and reports ablation/human studies.
records.caveat: Source-level claims checked; numerical results and benchmark release were not independently reproduced.

records.name: IntentEdit
records.title: IntentEdit: Multi-Agent Reasoning for Intent-Driven Complex Image Editing
records.mechanism: Combines a cognitive planner, complementary image editors and a reflective evaluator for iterative correction of abstract and concrete requests.
records.evidence: Official CVPR Findings abstract identifies RISE and RISE-MIX Bench evaluation.
records.caveat: A training-free agent framework; no evidence of free-form generated image code.

records.name: EditAgent
records.title: EditAgent: Rethinking Agentic Image Editing
records.mechanism: Routes to general and specialist editors, generates parallel candidates, supplies operation-specific verification records to a listwise judge, and checks earlier edits across turns.
records.evidence: Section 5.1 evaluates EdiVal, Complex-Edit and ComplexBench-Edit; diagnostic expert annotation studies candidate quality and judge reliability.
records.caveat: Some comparison agents are reimplemented with changed backbones/judges; the paper also reports substantial inference overhead.

records.name: Agent Banana
records.title: Agent Banana: High-Fidelity Image Editing with Agentic Thinking and Tooling
records.mechanism: A hierarchical planner-executor compresses dialogue into structured memory and edits decomposed image layers to preserve non-target content.
records.evidence: The paper explicitly describes planner verification, replanning and rollback over an image-state graph, and introduces HDD-Bench.
records.caveat: Layer localization and preservation are the key claims; ordinary low-resolution benchmark results do not certify native-resolution behavior.
records.evidence_granularity: primary abstract and paper planner-executor section
records.evidence_level: primary abstract and paper planner-executor section

records.name: RestoreAgent
records.title: RestoreAgent: Autonomous Image Restoration Agent via Multimodal Large Language Models
records.mechanism: An MLLM assesses degradations, chooses restoration tasks and their order, selects specialist models and executes them.
records.evidence: The abstract verifies all four control decisions and experiments on mixed degradation.
records.caveat: Tool composition is established; free-form source generation and visual rollback are not inferred from the abstract.

records.name: MAIR
records.title: Multi-Agent Image Restoration
records.mechanism: Coordinates a scheduler and specialist agents around a prior that reverses scene, imaging and compression degradations in opposite order.
records.evidence: Primary abstract reports synthetic and real-world restoration comparisons and efficiency analysis.
records.caveat: The degradation-order prior narrows planning; it is not a proof that all image corruptions follow that ordering.

records.name: HybridAgent
records.title: Hybrid Agents for Image Restoration
records.mechanism: Combines fast language-based routing, a slower multimodal degradation analyzer and feedback; supports mixed-distortion removal to reduce cascading restoration errors.
records.evidence: Primary abstract describes the fast, slow and feedback agents and synthetic/real-world validation.
records.caveat: Distinguish the routing controller from the jointly trained restoration toolbox.

records.name: JarvisIR
records.title: JarvisIR: Elevating Autonomous Driving Perception with Intelligent Image Restoration
records.mechanism: Uses a VLM controller to select expert restoration models, trained with supervised fine-tuning and human-feedback alignment.
records.evidence: Primary abstract introduces CleanBench and reports restoration and downstream perception evaluation.
records.caveat: Driving-perception evidence does not establish fidelity for arbitrary creative edits.

records.name: 4KAgent
records.title: 4KAgent: Agentic Any Image to 4K Super-Resolution

records.caveat: Dependency-aware questions improve diagnostic structure but do not make VQA infallible.

records.name: StructBench / StructScore
records.title: Factuality Matters: When Image Generation and Editing Meet Structured Visuals
records.mechanism: Uses factual questions to assess generated and edited charts, diagrams and mathematical figures; includes an accompanying structured-visual model and training data.
records.evidence: Primary abstract states executable-program-derived training pairs and multi-round question-based StructScore.
records.caveat: The evaluated visual model is not automatically a coding agent; rendered factuality and source-program validity are separate.

records.name: SciFlow-Bench
records.title: SciFlow-Bench: Evaluating Structure-Aware Scientific Diagram Generation via Inverse Parsing
records.mechanism: Pairs source scientific diagrams with canonical graphs and inverse-parses rendered generated images into graphs for structural comparison through a round-trip protocol.
records.evidence: Primary ACL abstract verifies evaluation of final pixel outputs rather than only intermediate code or symbolic plans; hierarchy and topology motivate the graph-based protocol.
records.caveat: The multi-agent inverse parser is an evaluator, not evidence that the evaluated image generators are coding agents. Parsing errors can affect recovered structure.

records.name: VAO-Bench
records.title: Pixels or Code? Benchmarking Instruction-Guided Visual Artifact Operation
records.mechanism: Tests direct edits, dependent updates and preservation across pixel editors, code-generating systems and tool agents under a common image-only input protocol.
records.evidence: Primary abstract specifies executable reference artifacts, deterministic rendering and assessments of domain validity and visual quality.
records.caveat: Do not give code systems original source when reporting the paper’s image-only comparison; this changes the task.

records.name: EditBench
records.title: Imagen Editor and EditBench: Advancing and Evaluating Text-Guided Image Inpainting
records.mechanism: Evaluates text-guided inpainting with object, attribute and scene categories.
records.evidence: Primary abstract and official project describe masked image/text input and human evaluation.
records.caveat: This is an inpainting protocol, not unrestricted editing or a coding-agent benchmark.

records.name: MagicBrush
records.title: MagicBrush: A Manually Annotated Dataset for Instruction-Guided Image Editing
records.mechanism: Provides source-instruction-target triplets for single-turn, multi-turn, masked and mask-free editing.
records.evidence: Primary abstract identifies manual annotation and multidimensional evaluation.
records.caveat: Its released train/test splits and single/multi-turn settings must be specified.

records.name: PIE-Bench
records.title: Direct Inversion: Boosting Diffusion-based Editing with 3 Lines of Code
records.mechanism: Introduces annotated image-editing cases for examining prompt alignment and preservation, alongside an inversion method.
records.evidence: Primary abstract identifies PIE-Bench and comparison across editing methods.
records.caveat: The inversion method’s short code change does not make it a language-model coding agent.

records.name: ImgEdit-Bench
records.title: ImgEdit: A Unified Image Editing Dataset and Benchmark
records.mechanism: Provides basic, challenging single-turn and multi-turn suites measuring instruction adherence, editing quality and detail preservation.
records.evidence: Primary abstract distinguishes the large training dataset, ImgEdit-E1 model and evaluation suites.
records.caveat: Training-pair count is not benchmark size; different suites should not be merged into one score without protocol details.

records.name: GEdit-Bench
records.title: Step1X-Edit: A Practical Framework for General Image Editing
records.mechanism: Introduces a benchmark from real-world editing instructions alongside an MLLM-conditioned image editor.
records.evidence: Primary abstract names GEdit-Bench and its user-instruction basis.
records.caveat: Step1X-Edit is an editing backbone; its MLLM does not by itself establish an agent loop. Do not confuse original GEdit-Bench with v2.

records.name: CompBench
records.title: CompBench: Benchmarking Complex Instruction-guided Image Editing
records.mechanism: Evaluates detailed spatial and contextual editing instructions, with intent decomposition across location, appearance, dynamics and objects.
records.evidence: Primary abstract describes MLLM-human construction and the four editing dimensions.
records.caveat: Different from T2I-CompBench, Complex-Edit and ComplexBench-Edit. Name and source identifier must stay paired.

records.name: Complex-Edit
records.title: Complex-Edit: CoT-Like Instruction Generation for Complexity-Controllable Image Editing Benchmark
records.mechanism: Constructs editing instructions of controllable complexity by composing atomic tasks and scores output with a VLM-based pipeline.
records.evidence: The primary abstract reports that naive sequential decomposition can degrade preservation and aesthetic quality in the tested setup.
records.caveat: Do not generalize that negative result to every feedback-controlled planner; the execution policy matters.

records.name: ComplexBench-Edit
records.title: ComplexBench-Edit: Benchmarking Complex Instruction-Driven Image Editing via Compositional Dependencies
records.mechanism: Tests multi-instruction and chain-dependent edits and evaluates untouched regions after excluding edited areas.
records.evidence: Primary abstract distinguishes complex chains and proposes a CoT-based baseline.
records.caveat: Unlike Complex-Edit, this is a different benchmark with a different composition protocol.

records.name: KRIS-Bench
records.title: KRIS-Bench: Benchmarking Next-Level Intelligent Image Editing Models
records.mechanism: Organizes reasoning-based edits by factual, conceptual and procedural knowledge and evaluates knowledge plausibility.
records.evidence: Primary abstract describes the taxonomy, annotations and human-calibrated protocol.
records.caveat: Knowledge hints and judge configuration are part of the evaluation contract.

records.name: InEdit-Bench
records.title: InEdit-Bench: Benchmarking Intermediate Logical Pathways for Intelligent Image Editing Models
records.mechanism: Tests coherent intermediate visual states in state transitions, processes, temporal sequences and scientific simulations.
records.evidence: Primary abstract defines pathway coherence, naturalness and path-constraint fidelity.
records.caveat: Intermediate-image evaluation is not a full interactive video-world benchmark.

records.name: EdiVal-Agent / EdiVal-Bench
records.title: EdiVal-Agent: An Object-Centric Framework for Automated, Scalable, Fine-Grained Evaluation of Multi-Turn Editing
records.mechanism: Combines VLMs, object detection, semantic features and preference models to evaluate instruction following, consistency and quality across edits.
records.evidence: Primary abstract and official repository describe the object-centric evaluator and benchmark.
records.caveat: The evaluator is agentic, but it is not an image-creation agent; benchmark judges and generator controllers play different roles.

records.name: GEditBench v2 / PVC-Judge
records.title: GEditBench v2: A Human-Aligned Benchmark for General Image Editing
records.mechanism: Broadens real-world editing coverage and introduces a pairwise consistency judge plus VCReward-Bench for human agreement.
records.evidence: Primary abstract explicitly distinguishes editing-model evaluation from judge evaluation.
records.caveat: A consistency judge assesses preservation; it is not a complete measure of instruction success or visual quality.

records.name: ChartJudgeBench
records.title: ChartJudgeBench: Evaluating LMM Judges for Chart-to-Code Generation
records.mechanism: Tests pairwise chart comparison and accept/reject judgments for reproduction and editing.
records.evidence: Primary abstract reports positional, acceptance and other judging biases.
records.caveat: A critic diagnostic, not a chart-generation performance benchmark.

records.name: EditScore / EditReward-Bench
records.title: EditScore: Unlocking Online RL for Image Editing via High-Fidelity Reward Modeling
records.mechanism: Develops specialized editing reward models, self-ensemble scoring and a reward benchmark before applying the scorer to online reinforcement learning.
records.evidence: Primary abstract names EditReward-Bench and distinguishes reward-model evaluation from downstream editor training.
records.caveat: A critic is a component, not an autonomous image author; judge agreement is benchmark-specific.

records.name: FIRM / FIRM-Bench
records.title: Trust Your Critic: Robust Reward Modeling and Reinforcement Learning for Faithful Image Editing and Generation
records.mechanism: Trains separate editing and generation reward models and evaluates critic agreement using FIRM-Bench; editing considers execution and consistency.
records.evidence: Primary abstract explicitly targets reward-model hallucinations and human-aligned assessment.
records.caveat: Use to discuss critic validation; it is not a code-generation method.

records.name: ImageReward
records.title: ImageReward: Learning and Evaluating Human Preferences for Text-to-Image Generation
records.mechanism: Learns a text-image reward from human rankings and proposes reward-feedback fine-tuning.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies human-preference learning and ReFL.
records.caveat: A preference score does not certify exact count, text transcription, factuality or source preservation.

records.name: Sketch2Code
records.title: Sketch2Code: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for Interactive Web Design Prototyping
records.mechanism: Evaluates initial prototypes and revisions from simulated-user feedback or agent clarification questions.
records.evidence: Official project and repository verify direct and multi-turn protocols.
records.caveat: Simulated user interaction is a distinct evidence condition from an autonomous visual critic.

records.name: Web2Code
records.title: Web2Code: A Large-scale Webpage-to-Code Dataset and Evaluation Framework for Multimodal LLMs
records.mechanism: Constructs screenshot/instruction-to-HTML data and evaluates webpage understanding plus code reconstruction.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies instruction tuning and evaluation framework.
records.caveat: HTML renderer is shared with graphic design, but this work studies webpages rather than image-art agents.

records.name: AMACE

records.mechanism: A Chart Code Generator, Chart Replier and Chart Quality Evaluator collaborate in an iterative loop to tailor generated charts to the intended query.
records.evidence: Primary ACL abstract and paper evaluation passage describe iteration across chart-understanding-derived tasks and a human comparison of successive rendered versions.

records.title: AutoPP: Towards Automated Product Poster Generation and Optimization
records.task: product poster generation and performance optimization
records.mechanism: Jointly designs background, text and layout, encodes elements as condition tokens for image rendering, and uses element replacement plus isolated preference optimization from click-through feedback.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies unified design, conditional rendering, online CTR feedback and AutoPP1M.
records.caveat: The inspected source does not establish executable graphic-code authoring; include as an adjacent design and outcome-optimization comparison. Online optimization is not evidence of an interactive coding-agent loop.

records.name: ChartCoder
records.title: ChartCoder: Advancing Multimodal Large Language Model for Chart-to-Code Generation
records.mechanism: Uses a code-language-model backbone, chart/code data and Snippet-of-Thought supervision for chart reconstruction.
records.evidence: Primary abstract identifies Chart2Code-160k and staged code supervision.
records.caveat: Stepwise supervised generation is not an execution-feedback agent; pixel similarity does not prove original data recovery.

records.mechanism: Decomposes an SVG into marked-up structure and a data-encoding representation, then synthesizes a D3.js template. An assistant observes the current canvas and program, edits data/design logic, and exposes new parameters as interactive widgets.
records.evidence: Primary full text Sections 2.4 and 3.2 verify code synthesis, canvas-conditioned updates, checkpointed state and widget controls; the paper reports a user study of replication and free-form exploration.

records.evidence: Primary abstract and ICCV paper explain training-data decoupling and compare generated graphics with caption-aligned and commercial baselines.
records.caveat: The zero-shot designation concerns absence of aligned caption-program examples in TikZero training; TikZero+ is explicitly not zero-shot in that sense. A trained generator is not by itself an inference-time agent.

records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies five agents and repository-based UML evaluation.

records.evidence: Primary abstract describes a working prototype and simulated evaluation.

records.evidence: Primary abstract identifies revision-derived DaEdiTikZ and human-refined DaEdiTikZ-Bench.

records.name: SAGE

records.mechanism: Maps diagrams to editable graphs, translates natural-language edits into structured operations, validates XML and stores recoverable versions.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies Draw.io/Mermaid workflows and a Kubernetes case study.
records.caveat: Case-study and unit-test evidence should not be presented as a large general diagram benchmark.

records.name: Vizart

records.mechanism: Retrieves examples, plans scenes and code, incrementally emits SVG and routes rubric feedback to responsible stages.
records.evidence: Official EDM paper describes iterative agents and an initial subject-domain study.
records.caveat: Initial evaluation is limited; pedagogical correctness should not be inferred from the LLM judge alone.

records.name: SLD
records.title: Self-correcting LLM-controlled Diffusion Models
records.mechanism: An LLM assesses prompt-image alignment and selects corrective edits in a training-free closed loop.
records.evidence: Primary abstract reports corrections for numeracy, attribute binding and spatial relations, including API-generated images.
records.caveat: Do not repeat the abstract wording as a guarantee that every output is correct.

records.name: CompAgent
records.title: Divide and Conquer: Language Models can Plan and Self-Correct for Compositional Text-to-Image Generation
records.mechanism: An LLM decomposes concepts and predicts layouts, composes independently generated objects, and uses verification and human feedback for local correction.
records.evidence: Primary abstract documents tool-based composition and T2I-CompBench evaluation.
records.caveat: Do not confuse with the unrelated 2025 visual-compliance-verification paper also named CompAgent.

records.name: DiffusionGPT
records.title: DiffusionGPT: LLM-Driven Text-to-Image Generation System
records.mechanism: An LLM parses diverse prompts and traverses domain-specific model trees; advantage databases incorporate human preferences.
records.evidence: Primary abstract describes model selection via Trees-of-Thought.
records.caveat: Selecting a generator is distinct from generating executable image programs.

records.name: MUSES
records.title: MUSES: 3D-Controllable Image Generation via Multi-Modal Agent Collaboration
records.mechanism: Layout Manager lifts 2D plans to 3D; Model Engineer retrieves/generates and aligns objects; Blender renders depth/edge conditions for ControlNet.
records.evidence: Full-text method explicitly distinguishes planning, object acquisition, Blender conditioning and final image synthesis.
records.caveat: The final task is a static image. Blender use does not alone prove the LLM writes arbitrary Blender Python.

records.name: GenPilot
records.title: GenPilot: A Multi-Agent System for Test-Time Prompt Optimization in Image Generation
records.mechanism: Error analysis, clustering-based exploration, fine-grained verification and memory iteratively optimize text prompts at test time.
records.evidence: Primary abstract names DPG-Bench and GenEval evaluations.
records.caveat: A model-agnostic prompt optimization baseline, not an image-program generator.

records.name: IA-T2I
records.title: IA-T2I: Internet-Augmented Text-to-Image Generation
records.mechanism: Active retrieval decides when references are needed, hierarchical selection chooses images, and reflection evaluates and refines generation.
records.evidence: Primary abstract identifies Img-Ref-T2I categories of rare, unknown and ambiguous knowledge.
records.caveat: Retrieval success, entity identity and rendered faithfulness must be measured separately.

records.name: ImAgent
records.title: ImAgent: A Unified Multimodal Agent Framework for Test-Time Scalable Image Generation
records.mechanism: A policy controller combines reasoning, generation and self-evaluation actions in one multimodal framework at test time.
records.evidence: Primary abstract states training-free operation and no reliance on external models for this loop.
records.caveat: Do not confuse ImAgent with similarly named multi-image-understanding systems; internal actions are not arbitrary code.

records.name: LayerCraft
records.title: LayerCraft: Enhancing Text-to-Image Generation with CoT Reasoning and Layered Object Integration
records.mechanism: A coordinator and ChainArchitect create dependency-aware 3D layouts; a LoRA-trained Object-Integration Network inserts objects into image regions.
records.evidence: Primary abstract describes layout reasoning and learned object integration.
records.caveat: The integration network is not itself an LLM agent; procedural layout is not proof of arbitrary code generation.

records.name: Maestro
records.title: Maestro: Self-Improving Text-to-Image Generation via Agent Orchestration
records.mechanism: Specialized critics propose interpretable edit signals; a verifier preserves user intent; head-to-head judging guides prompt candidate evolution.
records.evidence: Primary abstract distinguishes self-critique and self-evolution with black-box image models.
records.caveat: Prompt evolution differs from persistent code repair; self-judging does not establish independent evaluation.

records.name: MCCD
records.title: MCCD: Multi-Agent Collaboration-based Compositional Diffusion for Complex Text-to-Image Generation
records.mechanism: Specialized multimodal agents parse scene elements; hierarchical compositional diffusion refines bounding-box regions through masks and region enhancement.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies multi-agent parsing and training-free use of the proposed inference framework.
records.caveat: Multiple named agents should not be taken as evidence of code execution or independent visual verification.

records.name: APE
records.title: APE: Agentic Prompt Enhancer for Image Generation and Editing
records.mechanism: Post-trained small language models rewrite prompts directly or through router, rewriter and composer roles.
records.evidence: Primary abstract differentiates single-pass SAPE and staged multi-agent MAPE.
records.caveat: The title agentic does not establish an execute-inspect-revise loop; the downstream visual model remains unchanged.

records.name: coDrawAgents
records.title: coDrawAgents: A Multi-Agent Dialogue Framework for Compositional Image Generation
records.mechanism: Interpreter selects direct or layout-aware generation; Planner proposes groups of objects, Checker validates layouts, and Painter updates the visual canvas.
records.evidence: Primary abstract specifies checks occur before layout rendering, with subsequent planning grounded in the evolving image.
records.caveat: Distinguish pre-render layout checks from critique of a fully rendered final artifact.

records.name: GEMS
records.title: GEMS: Agent-Native Multimodal Generation with Memory and Skills
records.mechanism: A multi-agent generation loop uses persistent trajectory memory, compressed experience and on-demand domain skills.
records.evidence: Primary abstract documents loop/memory/skills and evaluation across general and downstream tasks.
records.caveat: Inspired by coding-agent harnesses does not mean every generation action writes executable source.

records.name: GenEvolve
records.title: GenEvolve: Self-Evolving Image Generation Agents via Tool-Orchestrated Visual Experience Distillation
records.mechanism: Tool trajectories gather evidence and references; best/worst trajectory comparisons create privileged teacher experience for token-level student distillation.
records.evidence: Primary abstract names GenEvolve-Data and GenEvolve-Bench.
records.caveat: Prompt-reference program is the authors orchestration term; do not infer Python execution or a persistent editable visual program.

records.name: Gen-Searcher
records.title: Gen-Searcher: Reinforcing Agentic Search for Image Generation
records.mechanism: An SFT/RL-trained agent performs multi-hop search for textual facts and reference images, using dual textual/image reward signals.
records.evidence: Primary abstract introduces KnowGen and names knowledge-grounded evaluation.
records.caveat: Separate agent retrieval correctness from generator image quality; benchmark results depend on the retrieval environment.

records.name: MemoGen
records.title: MemoGen: Can Past Experience Improve Future Text-to-Image Generation?
records.mechanism: A training-free agent acquires evidence, states visual constraints, evaluates results and reuses successes/failures across later tasks.
records.evidence: Primary abstract states no generator parameter update and selective repair while preserving successes.
records.caveat: Memory evolution protocols require a clear split between experience acquisition and evaluation.

records.name: MetaPoint
records.title: MetaPoint: Unlocking Precise Spatial Control in Agentic Visual Generation
records.mechanism: Special coordinate tokens use positional encodings to specify points or bounding boxes; a planner can compose these primitives.
records.evidence: Primary abstract verifies the coordinate-token interface.
records.caveat: This is a control mechanism useful to agents; it does not itself show a full coding agent.

records.name: Mind-Brush
records.title: Mind-Brush: Integrating Agentic Cognitive Search and Reasoning into Image Generation
records.mechanism: The agent retrieves multimodal evidence and reasons about implicit visual constraints before synthesis.
records.evidence: Primary abstract introduces Mind-Bench for recent knowledge, emerging concepts and mathematical/geographical reasoning.
records.caveat: Search and reasoning support the generator; do not describe it as code-based canvas construction.

records.name: Generation Navigator
records.title: Generation Navigator: A State-Aware Agentic Framework for Image Generation
records.mechanism: A state-conditioned policy steers subsequent actions; PRE-GRPO rewards peak quality, retaining good results and efficient trajectories.
records.evidence: Primary abstract explicitly identifies the credit-assignment issue and three reward components.
records.caveat: Reported improvements are task/model-specific; no code-generation capability follows from an action-policy interface.

records.name: OctoT2I
records.title: OctoT2I: A Self-Evolving Agentic Text-to-Image Router
records.mechanism: Stateful multi-round routing uses memory of tool abilities learned through a propose-solve-evaluate-learn exploration loop.
records.evidence: Primary abstract treats quality and inference efficiency jointly.
records.caveat: Efficiency comparisons depend on the particular model/tool pool and hardware; do not present them as general system guarantees.

records.name: Unify-Agent
records.title: Unify-Agent: A Unified Multimodal Agent for World-Grounded Image Synthesis
records.mechanism: A trained unified multimodal agent understands prompts, searches evidence, constructs grounded recaptions and synthesizes images.
records.evidence: Primary abstract introduces FactIP for long-tail factual concepts.
records.caveat: World-grounded image synthesis is not a video world model or persistent executable world simulator.

records.name: Simplified vector graphics control

records.mechanism: Images are parsed into hierarchical semantic vector graphics; modified layers guide photorealistic synthesis.

records.name: WeAgent-MMGenEdit

records.mechanism: A multimodal runtime manages persistent evidence and dedicated verification/integration tools; SFT and RL post-train both the agent policy and image backend.

records.name: InterleaveThinker
records.title: InterleaveThinker: Reinforcing Agentic Interleaved Generation
records.mechanism: A planner organizes image-text steps while a critic detects deviations and revises generation instructions; supervised warm starts and stepwise GRPO train the agents.

records.name: Iterative Refinement

records.mechanism: Repeated image generation/refinement follows VLM feedback about compositional mistakes.

records.mechanism: Tests native spreadsheet charting/repair, cross-framework artifact adaptation and clarification with a user simulator.
records.evidence: Primary abstract and official project verify DV-Sheet, DV-Evolution and DV-Interact, with value alignment plus visual assessment.
